'''Dzoun''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that joined a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] cult known as the [[Order of Revan|Revanites]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Dzoun lived in a camp near [[Kaas City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] when he introduced himself to a new cult member, who was secretly hired by [[Emic Sandor]] to spy on the Revanites and find out who the [[Tari Darkspanner|Master]] was.
